For the parent tuples G_+=(y_i+P_i) and G_-=(y_i+R_i), any old Q in both degree-C NS consequence spaces of Gamma_0+G_+ and Gamma_0+G_-, C>=2h+1, is an old Gamma consequence through C+1; likewise for PC. Nevertheless selecting input one in both parents gives weighted companion normalization with W=y_1 through degree five, conditional on old survival, and full original replay at D>=B+1, B>=max(old width,2h^2+3h). The universal common-target demand fails; no general companion-normalization impossibility or Frege lower bound is asserted.
